title: Fixed training classes yield similar public boundary rates across ZL, IT and RF; register a held-out class metric
statement: Public-only partial investigation of K-048-open-1; this does not evaluate the hidden pages. Using the grapheme pool and longest-match tokenizer from the author's released grille.py/signatures_v27.py (https://github.com/labyrinthinesecurity/currier-signatures; token pool encoded in analysis_script), count certain alphabetic words of at least two EVA characters from paragraph lines shared by all three witnesses. Excluded words remain barriers, and words from different lines never form pairs. Fit each grapheme's class on ZL public practice-training pages: start if initial count > twice final, end if final > twice initial, else ambiguous; freeze these classes for all measurements. Restrict to loci common to ZL, IT and RF for both uncertain-space policies. The fixed class set has 22 start, 27 end and 13 ambiguous units; no evaluated boundary uses an unseen class. On public practice evaluation pages, end-to-start rates (and adjacent-pair counts) are ZL split 0.72335 (4475), ZL join 0.73639 (4298), IT split/join 0.71886 (4592), RF split 0.71663 (3723), and RF join 0.72103 (3685). Raw boundary mutual information in bits is 0.39556, 0.36607, 0.38100, 0.38100, 0.42186, 0.41794 respectively; mean MI under 100 fixed-seed whole-word shuffles within each complete eligible run is 0.20395, 0.20195, 0.19582, 0.19582, 0.23484, 0.23252. Shuffle residuals are biased positive, and these are not directly comparable to the paper's corpus-wide figures: the present sample, frozen classes, paragraph-only selection, uncertainty handling and line-local shuffles differ. The witnesses share manuscript pages and transcription conventions; common locus matching does not align each word. This demonstrates only public robustness of these particular descriptive quantities, not the paper's full joint signatures or a language comparison. Current trusted measurement language has no end/start-class statistic whose classes are fitted on training pages and frozen on evaluation pages; hidden evaluation and an independent implementation remain required.
check: Independently reproduce these public numbers using the embedded script and pinned witness files. Add a reviewed, bounded scorer primitive for fixed training-derived grapheme classes and the selected boundary statistic, calibrate false positive and power with language and mechanical controls, freeze its class rule and thresholds, then register a fact before scoring hidden ZL and IT pages. Separately evaluate boundary uncertainty and transliteration sensitivity without treating multiple witnesses of the same pages as independent samples.
